title: Proportion of Unutilised Child LifeSG Credits Disbursed in July 2025
what_it_is: Proportion of Unutilised Child LifeSG Credits Disbursed in July 2025

sections.label: Child LifeSG Credits utilisation
sections.summary: 83% of July 2025 Child LifeSG Credits are utilised, with reminders sent and no extension before July 2026 expiry.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for S ocial and Family Development)
sentences.text: As of April 2026, 83% of the Child LifeSG Credits (CLC) disbursed in July 2025 have been utilised.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for S ocial and Family Development)
sentences.text: The Ministry has been issuing reminders to utilise the credits via our social media platforms, as well as via the LifeSG app and SMS messages.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for S ocial and Family Development)
sentences.text: We will also send a final reminder to recipients with unused credits in June, before the credits expire in July 2026.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for S ocial and Family Development)
sentences.text: As there has been ample notice, there will be no extension.

sections.label: Budget 2025 child credits
sections.summary: Budget 2025 announced a $500 credit to children above 12, topped up to Edusave and Post-Secondary Education Accounts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: Having said so, together with this tranche of CLC, Budget 2025 also announced that there was, and it has already been topped up, a $500 credit to children above 12 years old; those aged 13 to 16, a $500 top-up to their Edusave Account, and aged 17 to 20, to their Post-Secondary Education Account.

sections.label: July 2025 credit tranche
sections.summary: A further $500 tranche will be given to children in July, and Large Family LifeSG Credits were disbursed last month.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: So, we know the number is healthy but we will want to do more, and we think the final reminder and the various public information announcements are useful in that regard.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: So, this July, there will be another tranche to all our children of $500.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: And last month, we have also disbursed the Large Family LifeSG Credits for eligible families.
